partner.seo.title: ILogic Partners Program | Market Your Software With Us
partner.seo.description: Built an ERP, CRM or an innovative system? Partner with ILogic on development, marketing and sales, with the scope and launch approach agreed together.
partner.breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
partner.systems.title: Systems we welcome
partner.hero.title: Your system deserves to reach business owners
partner.hero.text: Built a promising system and ready to take it further? ILogic brings development, marketing and sales expertise to help you add new capabilities and reach the right clients. Together, we define what the project needs and each team's role in a clear, fair partnership.
partner.diagram.label: The developer and ILogic collaborate to develop the system and bring it to business owners.
partner.why.title: From development to market, together
partner.why.you.title: What you do best
partner.why.you.text: The idea, technical expertise and building the system.
partner.why.us.title: What we do best
partner.why.us.text: A team that helps with development, new features and user experience, alongside reaching clients, marketing and sales.
partner.why.closing: We believe Arab developers can compete. What is often missing is a route to market.
partner.how.title: Four clear steps
partner.how.submit.title: Submit your system
partner.how.submit.text: Fill in a short form explaining the system and what makes it different.
partner.how.review.title: We review it
partner.how.review.text: Our team reviews the system, its idea, its quality and the market need.
partner.how.agree.title: We agree on terms
partner.how.agree.text: If it is a good fit, we contact you to agree on clear terms for working together.
partner.how.launch.title: We launch together
partner.how.launch.text: We collaborate on development, marketing and sales within the agreed scope, name and launch approach.
partner.criteria.title: Four signs of a system we welcome
partner.criteria.problem.text: We look for systems that save a business owner time or money.
partner.criteria.idea.text: We are not looking for another copy of what is already on the market.
partner.criteria.working.text: A working prototype or a system in use, rather than an idea alone.
partner.criteria.quality.result: it can be supported and scaled
partner.criteria.quality.text: Organized code and documentation that help with future development.
partner.offer.title: A partnership beyond a sale
partner.offer.marketing.title: Professional marketing
partner.offer.marketing.text: We present the system to the right audiences with messaging that makes its value clear.
partner.offer.sales.title: Sales
partner.offer.sales.text: Our team handles conversations and negotiations with potential clients.
partner.offer.development.title: Development for your next step
partner.offer.development.text: We review what the system needs, help develop it and add features that support its growth, within the scope agreed with you.
partner.offer.agreement.title: A clear agreement
partner.offer.agreement.text: We agree on a transparent partnership share before bringing the system to market.
partner.systems.text: Not sure your system fits? Submit it and we will let you know.
partner.apply.text: Fill in the form below with what you know now. It is fine if some details are not ready yet.
partner.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
partner.faq.complete.question: Does the system have to be complete?
partner.faq.complete.answer: No, but there must be a working prototype we can see. Ideas without an implementation are not a fit for the program at this stage.
partner.faq.types.question: What kinds of systems do you welcome?
partner.faq.types.answer: ERP, CRM, accounting, inventory and industry-specific systems, along with similar systems that solve a real problem.
partner.faq.revenue.question: How are returns calculated?
partner.faq.revenue.answer: We agree on a clear partnership share before any launch. Marketing begins only after the terms are written and agreed.
partner.faq.name.question: How is the system's market name decided?
partner.faq.name.answer: We agree with you on the name used for the system and how it is presented to the market before marketing and sales begin.
partner.faq.next.question: What happens after I apply?
partner.faq.next.answer: We review your application. If the system is a good fit, we contact you to agree on the next steps.
